title: The tensor product of sheaves is closed and right exact
statement:
In the situation of [det-def-sfb-sheaf-tensor-structure], for sheaves $\mathcal F,\mathcal G$ put
$\mathcal{H}om(\mathcal F,\mathcal G):=[\mathcal F,\mathcal G]$, the presheaf internal hom of
[det-def-sfb-sheaf-tensor-presheaf], which is a sheaf by [det-def-sfb-sheaf-tensor-hom-sheaf].
Then there are bijections
$$
\Hom_{\Sh}(\mathcal F\otimes\mathcal G,\mathcal H)\cong\Hom_{\Sh}\bigl(\mathcal G,\mathcal{H}om(\mathcal F,\mathcal H)\bigr),
$$
natural in all three variables. Hence $(\Sh(C,\mathcal A),\otimes)$ is closed symmetric monoidal,
and $\mathcal F\otimes-$ and $-\otimes\mathcal F$ preserve all colimits; in particular they are
additive and right exact.

proof.text: Install the global and slice enriched-Hom existence instances of [det-def-sfb-sheaf-tensor-presheaf]. The specified internal Hom and its maps are the existing presheaf internal Hom bundled as a sheaf, using [det-def-sfb-sheaf-tensor-hom-sheaf] and fullness of the inclusion.

For sheaves F,G define e : a(iF tensor iG) ≅ F tensor G by the inverse tensorator of the strong monoidal sheafification from [det-def-sfb-sheaf-tensor-structure], followed by the tensor of the counit isomorphisms of [def-weil-pbc-sheafification]. Counit and tensorator naturality prove naturality of e. Compose precomposition by e, the sheafification adjunction, the presheaf tensor-Hom adjunction of [det-def-sfb-sheaf-tensor-presheaf], and fullness to obtain E : Hom(F tensor G,H) ≃ Hom(G,Hom(F,H)). After applying the faithful sheaf inclusion, naturality in F,G,H follows from naturality of e, both naturality identities for the sheafification adjunction, curry_natural_right, curry_natural_left and curry_pre_app. This proves the stated bijection and its precise three-variable naturality formula.

Apply Mathlib CategoryTheory.Monoidal.Reflective.monoidalClosed to the sheafification adjunction of [def-weil-pbc-sheafification], with the strong monoidal reflector of [det-def-sfb-sheaf-tensor-structure] and the presheaf closed structure of [det-def-sfb-sheaf-tensor-presheaf]. This is precisely Day reflection in the unit route and supplies the closed structure field; the specified internal Hom identification and naturality were established explicitly in the preceding step.

The tensorLeft adjunction of the reflected closed structure preserves colimits in universe w by [lem-weil-pbc-left-adjoint-preserves-colimits]. The braided closed-category instance in Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Monoidal.Closed.Braided gives the analogous preservation for tensorRight using the symmetry of [det-def-sfb-sheaf-tensor-structure]. No construction of chosen sheaf colimits is necessary: preservation is obtained directly from the adjunctions. The coefficient size hypothesis is exactly [def-sp-grothendieck-abelian], as used to obtain the presheaf enriched Homs.

The coefficient preadditivity from [def-sp-abelian] induces preadditivity of sheaves. Sheaves have binary products by the existing sheaf limit instances, so HasBinaryBiproducts.of_hasBinaryProducts supplies the binary biproducts of [def-weil-additive-category].

For each tensor functor, use preservesBinaryBiproducts_of_preservesBinaryCoproducts and Functor.additive_of_preservesBinaryBiproducts to obtain the Additive property of [def-weil-pbc-additive-functor]. For tensorRight explicitly instantiate preservation in universe zero before this inference. For each tensor functor, PreservesColimitsOfSize.preservesFiniteColimits gives right exactness, with no change to the universe-w preservation fields. Package the nine fields into the required Nonempty structure.
